description.value:
Dynalar kept the idea that made the old Brimstone beloved: a firefighter who can't burn. The Salamander adds ankles built for jumping out of collapsing floors. It's still the one borg nobody in Night City hates.

Cost: 19,100eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 59 ([1d6/2] + 17d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Amplified Hearing, FBC Brimstone Coating, Fortified Ankles ×2, Heavy Subdermal Plating, Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, Popup Grenade Launcher ×2 (CO2 Grenades), Radar/Sonar Implant, Radio Communicator

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
